audit_summary: All 12 facts are directly supported by the cited repository files at base commit 3c5eca2ded3dd2b59ebaf23eb289453b5d2930f0.

facts.statement: The recursive option is defined to discover Python modules and packages in a filesystem subtree and defaults to false.
When recursive mode is enabled, check() eagerly replaces the supplied arguments with a tuple produced by _discover_files before checking files.
For a non-package directory, _discover_files walks the supplied path with os.walk and tests each walked root against ignore names, ignore patterns, and the live self.config.ignore_paths value.
When a walked root is ignored, recursive discovery records that root and skips it; otherwise, non-package roots yield every .py file without an additional per-file ignore test in this generator.
Ignore-path matching uses regular-expression match semantics against the element string passed to _is_ignored_file; basename-only ignore mechanisms are evaluated separately.
The ignore-paths option is documented as matching paths in either POSIX or Windows format and defaults to an empty list.
The ignore-path validator compiles each configured expression into Windows-form and POSIX-form alternatives.
The linter captures self.config.ignore_paths into the separate self._ignore_paths field during open().
Normal module expansion passes self._ignore_paths, rather than self.config.ignore_paths, to expand_modules.
Existing end-to-end recursive ignore-path tests pass ignore paths on the command line as patterns beginning with '.*' and assert that the targeted failing file is absent from the linted paths.
The older self-test for recursive ignore paths likewise uses command-line patterns '.*ignored.*' and '.*failing.*'; it does not exercise an anchored relative pattern from a configuration file.
Configuration tests verify that ignore-path expressions match both slash styles, but they do not combine project-file configuration, an anchored relative path, and recursive discovery.

scope_summary: At base commit 3c5eca2ded3dd2b59ebaf23eb289453b5d2930f0, recursive discovery consults the live config.ignore_paths value while later module expansion uses the separately captured _ignore_paths value. Existing recursive-ignore tests cover command-line patterns containing leading wildcards, but not an anchored relative ignore-path loaded from project configuration.
unknowns: The repository does not establish whether recursive discovery is intended to use the live self.config.ignore_paths value or the captured self._ignore_paths value.
The existing tests do not demonstrate the expected matching basis for anchored relative ignore-path expressions during recursive discovery.
